mapper.select: SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE pp.PROJECT_STATUS WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN'PASS' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECT' WHEN 'APPROVED_RETURN' THEN 'REVIEW' END AS status, '暂无工作流，后续sql加上此段逻辑' AS opinion FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE pp.investment_status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN'PASS' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 'REVIEW' END AS status, '暂无工作流，后续sql加上此段逻辑' AS opinion FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE cc.mortgage_status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'REVIEW' END AS status, '暂无工作流，后续sql加上此段逻辑' AS opinion FROM CON_CONTRACT cc INNER JOIN PRJ_PROJECT pp ON cc.PROJECT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER as orderNo, reqhd.ACTUAL_PAY_DATE as loanTime, reqhd.ACTUAL_HD_PAY_AMOUNT*100 as loanAmount, CASE reqhd.PAYMENT_APPROVED_STATUS WHEN 'PAID' THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'FAIL'END as status, reqhd.payment_type as type FROM prj_project pp LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc ON pp.PROJECT_ID = cc.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN csh_payment_req_hd reqhd ON reqhd.source_contract_id=cc.contract_id where pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER as orderNo, '1' as termNo, SYSDATE as trialTime, 100*100 as principal, 100*100 as interest, 10*100 as principalPenalty, 10*100 as interestPenalty, 1000*100 as payableAmount FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT MAX(pp.PROJECT_NUMBER) AS orderNo, LISTAGG(ccc.TIMES, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ccc.CONTRACT_ID) AS termNos, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS trialTime, SUM(ccc.PRINCIPAL)*100 AS principal, SUM(ccc.INTEREST)*100 AS interest, 1000*100 AS principalPenalty, 1000*100 AS interestPenalty, 1000*100 AS otherFee, 10000*100 AS payableAmount FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc ON pp.PROJECT_ID = cc.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW ccc ON cc.contract_id = ccc.contract_id WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND ccc.CF_ITEM=1 GROUP BY cc.CONTRACT_ID
SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, CASE pp.SIGN_STATUS WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'FINISHED' ELSE 'CREATED' END AS status FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp where pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}
SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, 'DEDUCT' repayType FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp where pp.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT pp.PROJECT_NUMBER AS orderNo, ccc.times AS termNo, ccc.PRINCIPAL*100 AS principal, ccc.INTEREST*100 AS interest, 100*100 AS principalPenalty, 10*100 AS interestPenalty, 10*100 AS otherFee, 1000*100 AS total, 'JSNO0000001' AS transactionNo, 'DKJYNO000001' AS externalDeductNo FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT cc ON pp.PROJECT_ID = cc.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW ccc ON cc.contract_id = ccc.contract_id WHERE pp.PROJECT_ID=#{projectId} AND ccc.CF_ITEM=1
